name: domain.semantic_kernel_engine
description: Microsoft Semantic Kernel orchestration engine: multi-agent group chats, step-based kernel processes, dynamic prompt template rendering, volatile semantic memory vector search, and OpenAPI connector execution

entrypoints.name: orchestrate_group_chat
entrypoints.description: Execute multi-agent collaborative discussions with speaker strategy, turn execution, and consensus/termination criteria

parameters.name: agents
parameters.description: List of agent specifications with {'name': str, 'role': str, 'instructions': str}

parameters.name: max_rounds
parameters.description: Maximum conversation turns for group chat

parameters.name: termination_keyword
parameters.description: Keyword string signaling consensus or completion (e.g. 'APPROVED')

entrypoints.name: execute_kernel_process
entrypoints.description: Execute step DAG and state machine processes with conditional event routing, step transitions, and state propagation

parameters.name: process_name
parameters.description: Name identifier for the process pipeline

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: List of process step definitions with {'step_id': str, 'action': str, 'input_key': str, 'output_key': str}

parameters.name: initial_state
parameters.description: Initial key-value dictionary state passed into process

entrypoints.name: render_semantic_prompt
entrypoints.description: Compile and render Handlebars or Jinja2 dynamic semantic prompt templates with nested variable substitution

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Prompt template string with {{variable}} or {{#helper}} placeholders

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Dictionary of variables to interpolate into template

entrypoints.name: search_semantic_memory
entrypoints.description: Run volatile vector similarity search against documents using cosine similarity scoring and relevance thresholding

parameters.name: documents
parameters.description: List of document objects with {'id': str, 'text': str, 'metadata': dict}

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matched documents to return

entrypoints.name: execute_openapi_plugin
entrypoints.description: Parse OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger specifications and execute REST operations with JSON Schema parameter validation

parameters.name: operation_id
parameters.description: Target operationId defined in OpenAPI spec

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: Input arguments mapped to path/query/body parameters
